annotations.title: Safely update or deactivate a plugin

description: WordPress sites: for a vulnerable or outdated plugin a run found (get_run warnings with a plugin), update it (or deactivate it) through the Relvato plugin, re-run the monitors that were passing, and undo it automatically if any of them breaks. Counts as runs. Follow it with get_safe_update. Get the user's go-ahead first.
